$comment: Ceilings for `yarn validate:anatomy-parts` (TASK-N2-S1, ADR-19). Both ratchet DOWN, never up -- raising one is how a styling contract quietly stops being one, which is the same rule `maxWithoutAnatomy` in ../ownership/unclassified-ceiling.json follows.
$comment.maxUndeclaredEmissions: Static `data-part="x"` sites that no anatomy declares -- neither the emitting component's own, nor a composing parent's, nor (for an unexported internal) every component that renders it. Initialised on 2026-09-02 at the measured value on this tree. The whole population is DzOptionsState.vue: an UNEXPORTED internal, absent from the ownership manifest and from component-meta.json, which emits `options-state`, `options-message` and `options-retry` into DzCascader, DzCombobox, DzListbox, DzMultiSelect, DzSelect, DzTransfer and DzTreeSelect. DzSelect is an ADR-19 PILOT and declares none of the three. It falls to 0 when the forms family slice completes; it cannot be closed component-by-component, because the internal's parts are governed only when EVERY host declares them.
$comment.maxUnemittedDeclarations: A declared, non-optional part that no source emits -- a promise with nothing behind it. Ceiling ZERO from the start: there was exactly one on this tree (DzFileUpload declared `parts: ['root']` and its template emitted no data-part at all), it was fixed in the same change that added this gate, and there is no reading under which a second one is acceptable.
